_metadata.description: OT-P0-003 — guided execution where status/next act as a just-in-time context server.

requirements.title: status/next inject phase-scoped context just-in-time
requirements.description: The start/status/context/resume/next commands return the current phase, what is next, structured relevant-context setup items, reminders, the last validation results, and current staleness — so the agent does not carry that procedural knowledge in context.

validation.notes: Status injects current phase, relevant context, reminders, next phase, staleness, and resume point.
Next advances to a later actionable phase while preserving the resume point.

requirements.title: Full vs partial completion and resume point are computed
requirements.description: Whether a run completed the whole plan or part of it, and where to resume, are derived from phase status — not narrated by the agent. A partial run yields a deterministic resume point.

validation.notes: Full versus partial completion is derived from phase status.
Complete computes full handoff state with no resume point when every phase is done.
